title: Exchange Student Life in Paris
excerpt: My experience as an exchange student at Sorbonne Université. From language barriers to cultural adaptation, this journey has been full of growth and learning...
content:
## Coming to Paris

When I first arrived at Charles de Gaulle Airport, everything felt surreal. The signs were in French, the announcements were in French, and I could barely understand a word. But that was exactly the challenge I had been looking for.

## Life at Sorbonne Université

Studying informatique at Sorbonne was a completely different experience from what I was used to in Taiwan. The teaching style, the way students interact with professors, and even the exam formats were all new to me.

## Cultural Adaptation

From learning to say "Bonjour" to everyone I meet, to understanding that lunch breaks are sacred, adapting to French culture was a journey in itself.

## What I Learned

This exchange experience taught me that growth happens outside your comfort zone. Every struggle with the language, every moment of homesickness, and every new friendship made me a stronger and more open-minded person.
